Q5460.reason: An employee's statement on a matter within the scope of employment is a party-opponent admission under FRE 801(d)(2)(D), so the objection fails.

Q8222.reason: Adenovirus fits the cold symptoms and fever together with kidney involvement in an immunosuppressed transplant recipient, while BK usually causes no fever or URI symptoms.

Q5849.reason: The defendant's bare testimony that he kept the records regularly doesn't establish the business-records foundation or authentication, so the court will require more, and being available in court doesn't cure hearsay.
